mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM email_verification WHERE ev_email = #{email} AND ev_expires_at > SYSDATE AND ev_verified = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_email_verification.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO email_verification (ev_id, ev_email, ev_code, ev_expires_at, ev_verified, created_at) VALUES (#{evId}, #{evEmail}, #{evCode}, #{evExpiresAt}, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET ev_verified = 1 WHERE ev_id = #{evId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_verification WHERE ev_expires_at < SYSDATE
